status: CANCELLED 2026-10-25 by the baseline plan (design.md D5), NOT RUN - no EXP-0043 labels or gate seeds inspected; code on archive-1 (7aeef1f)
question: Can a scenario-conditioned relational GNN certify zero-gain depth-2 bump evaluations and remove at least 70% of real rollout calls without losing depth-2 decisions or closed-loop value?
scope: Planner-internal cost reduction on the three fixed EXP-0042 topologies. Sampled future demand is explicit evaluator input to the surrogate and is not a deployable environment observation. blend_0.5 and real depth-2 rollout remain fallbacks.
target: For one current-state graph, candidate producer bump, and explicitly sampled future-demand suffix: consumer units from the depth-2 bumped rollout minus the paired blend_0.5 rollout.

data.future_features: per product: log1p(total scheduled quantity) and consumer count at each of the next two schedule positions
data.split_unit: whole episode; all four blocks are disjoint and disjoint from EXP-0037 through EXP-0042 gate seeds
data.label_budget: training records the adaptive planner scenarios; validation and test record all K=16 scenarios so hybrid stopping can be replayed exactly
data.balance: retain every non-deterministic-zero training stream; retain a deterministic SHA-256 10% sample of exact-zero training streams; validation and test are never sampled

models.normalization: graph and scenario normalizers fit on retained training rows only; early stopping uses a deterministic balanced 4096-scenario validation view, while adapter selection and every gate use every validation row

adapter.rule: if ensemble max absolute mean gain <= zero_abs and max ensemble standard deviation <= spread, emit exact zero gains for that stream/scenario; otherwise run the real paired depth-2 rollouts
adapter.selection: validation only; among passing configurations choose maximum rollout reduction, then maximum value-weighted recall, then smaller zero_abs and spread

offline_gate.recall_scope: both recall minima must hold globally and independently on every task
offline_gate.procedure: select arm and adapter on validation, lock them, then read the test labels once and apply the same gate

closed_loop_gate.death_rate: hybrid must not exceed paired depth-2 on any task
closed_loop_gate.route_integrity: finite actions and unchanged EXP-0042 allocator/fallback

run_order: collect train+validation -> fit/select on validation -> collect/read test -> offline test -> closed-loop test only after both offline gates pass
